newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela oilmin presents Orinoco plan to Congress.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela oilmin presents Orinoco plan to Congress.

text.p: Venezuela's Minister of Energy and Mines Erwin Arrieta presented to Congress on Thursday a heavy oil project involving state oil subsidiary Lagoven, Mobil and Veba.

"We are presenting to Congress for approval...a strategic association between the Venezuelan petroleum subsidiary Lagoven, Mobil and Veba to develop, treat and convert heavy crude from the Cerro Negro in the Orinoco Oil Belt," Arrieta told journalists.

The $2.5 billion project aims to produce 120,000 barrels per day of heavy crude from the Orinoco, upgrade it in a conversion plant in Venezuela and ship it to Mobil and Veba's refineries in the United States and Germany.
